title: ITAR export-scope applicability needs an authoritative deployment determination
remediation: The sponsor empowered official and trade counsel review which assessed deployment activities and information categories require an ITAR scope decision. Retain a signed applicability record that identifies the affected systems, evidence custody and unresolved questions. Keep any supporting controlled information in restricted custody and use approved references in the assessor package.

milestones.title: Collect a signed applicability review or pending-scope decision and protected references for the reviewed deployment boundary
